name: brain-engine
description: The code for a second brain: the brain command, the server, the phone app, the Worker and the design system.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p app && (cd app && node scripts/icons.mjs) && vite build app
scripts.storybook: npm run tokens && (cd app && storybook dev -p 6006)
scripts.build-storybook: npm run tokens && (cd app && storybook build)
scripts.test: f=0; npm run test:engine || f=1; npm run test:app || f=1; npm run test:worker || f=1; exit $f
scripts.typecheck: f=0; for p in engine app app/tsconfig.design.json worker; do tsc --noEmit -p $p || f=1; done; exit $f
scripts.lint: oxlint -c app/.oxlintrc.json app worker/src worker/test && stylelint "app/src/**/*.css"
scripts.size: node ops/scripts/size-check.mjs app/src engine/src engine/bin worker/src
scripts.check: f=0; npm run typecheck || f=1; npm run lint || f=1; npm run format:check || f=1; npm run size || f=1; exit $f
scripts.gates: f=0; npm test || f=1; npm run check || f=1; npm run privacy || f=1; npm run build || f=1; exit $f
scripts.deploy: node ops/scripts/refuse-under-agent.mjs && npm test && npm run build && worker/write-config.sh && (cd worker && wrangler deploy)
